items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 31 Dec (UK only). Effy steps up to the Residency hot seat with an introduction to her sound! Expect emotional electronic music, nostalgic EDM and deep house sounds with tracks from Dusky, Maya Jane Coles, Bicep and more. Plus, Effy invites French producer RONI into the CLUBGRL Mix to spin 30 minutes of music from the likes of Saidah, Ploy, I. JORDAN and more. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 1 Dance.
items.title: Effy - Nostalgia

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 24 Dec (UK only). Legend of the dance music scene, Jamie Jones, takes over the Residency for one night only, sharing loads of his favourite tracks and even some very special exclusive IDs. He also jumps in the mix exploring groovy house sounds. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 1 Dance.
items.title: One night with Jamie Jones

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 17 Dec (UK only). Sam Alfred brings the heat for his final Residency show packed full of peak time energy! Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 1 Dance.
items.title: Sam Alfred - Peak Time

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 10 Dec (UK only). Discover sounds from down under as Sam Alfred shares his favourite Aussie producers in a show all about the Australian Dance Music scene. Expect music from Confidence Man, HAAi, Mall Grab and more. Sam jumps in the mix spinning tracks to showcase the pool of talent from his home country, with music from Marli, CC Disco and more. And Australian podcaster and DJ Ricky Nord provides the guest mix with 30 minutes of Aussie selections. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 1 Dance.
items.title: Sam Alfred - Australian dance music

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 3 Dec (UK only). Expect a deeper more melodic side to Sam Alfred over the next two hours as he explores the art of the opening set with deep house and minimal sounds. With tracks from Leo Pol, Nathan Coles, Youandewan and more. Plus Sam jumps in the mix to showcase his approach to an opening set, with music from Maya Jane Coles, Robin Graham and Eden Burns. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 1 Dance.
items.title: Sam Alfred - The art of the opening set

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 26 Nov (UK only). Sam Alfred is a DJ and producer from Tasmania in Australia. He steps into the Residency hotseat with a celebration of US house music, a genre that has inspired his journey in music so far. Expect tracks from dance music legends like Kerri Chandler, Roger Sanchez, Inner City and more. Plus Sam jumps in the mix to share his favourite classic US house sounds. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 1 Dance.
items.title: Sam Alfred - US house

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 19 Nov (UK only). Paige Tomlinson has packed her final Residency show full of unreleased music from her herself, friends, and upcoming DJs and producers. If you're into hearing brand new music from one of the scene's finest tastemakers, this is the place to be. Expect music from Entasia, Kara Okay, Saidah, Bella Claxton and more. Plus Paige's good friend Kyle Starkey drops by for a chat and to provide his guest mix, full of exclusive and unreleased music. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 1 Dance.
items.title: Paige Tomlinson - Fresh from the studio
